Name: Rare Item and Unobtainable Item Source Plus
Author: mitekano23
Description:
- MOD Contents.
Add sources for items that have limited availability and are not available to the unlucky, and for items that are in the data but not implemented in the game.
However, the majority of items are not easily purchased with money.
You need to take steps related to how to obtain the item you are looking for. For example, collecting certain items, defeating monsters, or advancing beyond a certain point in the story.

- About having a portrait of the same spouse in the travel cart.
This is because it has been added as a new item in the mod in addition to what is in the vanilla game. If you are concerned about this, you can turn it off in the settings.
